# Year Projects

Year-specific projects contain generated C# code for each DRG/PEPP catalogue year + patient year combination.

## Naming Convention

`<Grouper>.<CatalogueYear>.<PatientYear>`

Examples:
- `DRG_2026_2026` — DRG catalogue 2026, patient year 2026
- `DRG_2026_2024` — DRG catalogue 2026, patient year 2024
- `PEPP_2025_2023` — PEPP catalogue 2025, patient year 2023

## Current Year Projects

The solution contains **31 year projects** (16 DRG + 15 PEPP) covering various catalogue/patient year combinations.

## Generated by DefinitionTranslator

Each year project is generated by the [[DefinitionTranslator]] from InEK specification files:

```bash
dotnet run --project Grouper\DefinitionTranslator -- \
  --spec-root Specifications \
  --year-id DRG_2026_2026 \
  --no-scaffold
```

## Thread-Safe Grouper Pattern

Each year project generates a `YearGrouper_<ID>` class that extends `YearGrouperBase`:

```csharp
public class YearGrouper_DRG_2026_2026 : YearGrouperBase
{
    public override GrouperMetadata Metadata { get; }
    protected override void InitializeCore() { /* load registries */ }
    protected override GroupingContext CreateContext() { /* wire components */ }
    protected override void ExecuteLogic(GroupingContext ctx) { /* MainLogic.Execute(ctx) */ }
}
```

`YearGrouperBase` provides:
- Double-checked lazy initialization
- `ConcurrentBag<GroupingContext>` pooling
- Thread-safe `Group(CaseData)` execution path
- Automatic context rent/return with `try/finally`

## Auto-Registration

Each year project generates a `GrouperRegistrar`:

```csharp
[assembly: GrouperAssembly(typeof(GrouperRegistrar))]

public static class GrouperRegistrar
{
    public static void Register(GrouperRegistry registry)
    {
        registry.Register("DRG.2026.2026", () => new YearGrouper_DRG_2026_2026());
    }
}
```

Discovery by consumers:
```csharp
var registry = new GrouperRegistry();
registry.AddFromDirectory(AppContext.BaseDirectory);  // scans DLLs
// or
registry.AddFromLoadedAssemblies();  // scans already-loaded assemblies
```

## GrouperMetadata

Each grouper exposes identity metadata:
- **Key**: `"{Entgelt}.{CatalogueYear}.{BaseYear}"` (e.g., `"DRG.2026.2026"`)
- **Entgelt**: `"DRG"` or `"PEPP"`
- **CatalogueYear**: The DRG/PEPP catalogue year
- **BaseYear**: The patient data year

## Consumer Integration

```csharp
// In-process (year projects referenced directly)
var registry = new GrouperRegistry();
registry.AddFromLoadedAssemblies();
var grouper = registry.Get("DRG.2026.2026");

// Thread-safe parallel processing
Parallel.ForEach(cases, c => {
    var result = grouper.Group(c);
});

// Plug-in deployment (year DLLs dropped next to host)
registry.AddFromDirectory(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
```
